user.title: Create a light compositor
user.description: Select a light or a compatible Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT light group. Native Zigbee2MQTT groups require discovered membership and compatible MQTT members on the same bridge. The base is fixed after setup. Leave Name empty to use the base's name. Setup starts with Apply off. Use the generated Main control light in ordinary lighting automations instead of the base; it remembers everyday power, brightness and color beneath the masks. Use separate masks for notifications. Do not also control the base or group members from other automations.

data.name: Name
data.output: Base light or compatible light group
data.power_port: Create an optional power-only alias (shares Main control state)

data_description.multi_zone: Optional: configure at least two disjoint native groups with shared masks. Leave Base empty; Power alias is ignored in this mode. The following steps collect zones and an optional whole-room group. Ordinary controls must target the generated Main lights.

zone.title: Add a native zone
zone.description: {count} zones added. Each zone needs a disjoint Zigbee2MQTT group on the same bridge with identical capabilities. All members of each zone must have the same known power state during enrollment. Zone topology is fixed after setup.

aggregate.title: Review zones and optional aggregate
aggregate.description: Zones: {zones}. The optional native aggregate must contain exactly the union of these zones. It is used only when all zones are available and need identical commands; otherwise native zone groups are used. Whole Main is On if any ordinary zone is On; its toggle then requests all Off. Mixed color and brightness are not averaged. Masks apply to every zone. Unknown/unavailable members block only their zone; healthy zones continue with overall degraded status. Unsafe topology still blocks the compositor. Setup starts with Apply Off.

data.confirm: I will route ordinary controls through zone/whole Main lights, not physical outputs

error.native_zone_required: Multi-zone outputs must be recognized native Zigbee2MQTT groups, not individual bulbs or HA groups.
error.invalid_zones: Configure at least two distinct zones.
error.overlapping_zones: Zones must not share any member.
error.aggregate_cover: The aggregate must cover exactly all zone members, without missing or extra lights.
error.mixed_zone: Initialize this native zone to a uniform known On or Off state before enrolling it.
error.confirm_routing: Confirm Main facade routing before creating the compositor.
error.aggregate_output: Use a light, a registered Home Assistant light group, or a recognized Zigbee2MQTT group with explicit same-bridge MQTT members. Missing or invalid membership, cycles, repeated members, unknown groups, Lightener and Light Masks outputs are not supported.
error.incompatible_group: All group members must have identical supported color modes, color-temperature ranges and transition support.
error.group_changed: Group members changed. Recreate this Light Masks entry to review the new output.
error.unsupported_output: This output's color modes are not supported.
error.already_configured: Another Light Masks entry already owns this output or one of its members.

init.title: Configure Light Masks
init.description: {count} masks configured. Each mask is an independent light device. Configuration edits preserve active masks and their current deadlines.

zone_name.title: Rename zone
zone_name.description: Only the display name changes. Entity IDs, membership and stored ordinary intent remain unchanged.

base.title: Name and main control
base.description: Fixed base: {output}. Name labels this setup and its devices; it does not change entity IDs or lighting behavior. Use Main control for ordinary lighting automations, not the base. Main control remembers everyday power, brightness and color; masks temporarily override selected channels. Main control Off requests darkness, while mask Off releases that mask. Power-controlling masks can override Main control's power. To use a different base, create a new Light Masks entry.

add_mask.title: Add mask
add_mask.description: Choose which parts of the base light this mask may override. Turning the mask On activates those contributions; turning it Off removes them and reveals Main control or other active masks. Device-page permission indicators show these settings, not which mask currently wins.

data.name: Name
data.restore: Restore activation after restart or manual reload
data.duration: Maximum duration in seconds (0 disables expiry)

data_description.power: Unchecked: this mask cannot turn the base on or off; it only changes selected brightness/color when lighting is on. Checked: while active, it requests On at its priority, even if Main control is Off, unless a higher-priority power mask wins. Turning this mask Off releases its request; the base stays On if another request requires it. Apply and safety protections still apply.
data_description.brightness: Allow this mask's stored brightness to override lower-priority brightness. Unchecked: brightness remains local to this mask, even if Home Assistant's color-light card displays a brightness slider.
data_description.appearance: Allow this mask's stored RGB color or color temperature to override lower-priority color. Independent of Control brightness; only modes supported by the base are available.
data_description.priority: 100 overrides 10. The highest active priority wins each enabled channel separately. Priorities must be unique for this base.
data_description.duration: Automatically release the mask after this many seconds. Each turn_on action starts a fresh timer, including color/brightness updates while already On. 0 means no automatic release.

mask.title: Edit mask
mask.description: Saving keeps this mask's current On/Off state and stored values. Permission and priority changes take effect immediately. Device-page permission indicators update to match these settings.

data.name: Name
data.restore: Restore activation after restart or manual reload
data.duration: Maximum duration in seconds (0 disables expiry)
data.force_off: Compatibility: request Off instead of On while active

data_description.power: Unchecked: this mask cannot turn the base on or off; it only changes selected brightness/color when lighting is on. Checked: while active, it requests On at its priority, even if Main control is Off, unless a higher-priority power mask wins. Turning this mask Off releases its request; the base stays On if another request requires it. The compatibility option below, when present and checked, requests Off instead. Apply and safety protections still apply.
data_description.brightness: Allow this mask's stored brightness to override lower-priority brightness. Unchecked: brightness remains local to this mask, even if Home Assistant's color-light card displays a brightness slider.
data_description.appearance: Allow this mask's stored RGB color or color temperature to override lower-priority color. Independent of Control brightness; only modes supported by the base are available.
data_description.priority: 100 overrides 10. The highest active priority wins each enabled channel separately. Priorities must be unique for this base.
data_description.duration: Saving does not restart or change a running timer, even if you enter 0. For example, a mask with 20 seconds left still releases in 20 seconds. The next turn_on action uses the new duration, including an update while already On. 0 then disables automatic release.
data_description.force_off: Only shown for an older Off-requesting mask. With Control on/off checked, this makes an active mask request darkness at its priority. Turning the mask Off releases that request and may restore light. Uncheck this option to request On instead, or uncheck Control on/off to stop controlling power. Saving either change can immediately affect the base.

confirm_remove.title: Remove {name}?
confirm_remove.description: This removes the mask device and its saved state. Automations, scenes and dashboards referencing it are not rewritten. Removing an active mask reveals the lower-priority result and may change the physical light.

data.confirm: Remove this mask and its saved state

error.unsupported_appearance: The base light does not support color or color temperature.

external_change.title: Light Masks paused after an external change
external_change.description: The output {output} changed while masks were active, or a group member diverged from the requested state. Intent is preserved and output writes are paused. Stop competing physical/group writers, inspect Light Masks Explain, and press Resume when ready. Resume can turn the light on.

storage.title: Light Masks could not save intent
storage.description: A storage operation for {output} failed. Output writes are blocked. Check disk space, permissions and the Home Assistant log. After fixing storage, press Resume or reload. A rejected command must be submitted again.

delivery.title: Light Masks output did not converge
delivery.description: {output} did not reach the requested state after three attempts. Check connectivity, device capabilities and the log. No further attempts are made for this unchanged result until Sync, Resume or a new effective command.

endpoint.title: Light Masks output is no longer safe to control
endpoint.description: {output} has invalid feedback, unsupported capabilities, a conflicting owner, or changed group membership. Inspect the log and configuration before Resume. Reload after a capability change. For changed group membership, restore the original members or recreate the Light Masks entry.

explain.name: Explain
explain.description: Return stored intents, desired and observed state, and channel ownership. User calls require administrator permission.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Clear suspension and authorize the current intent, including On. Apply must also be enabled. User calls require administrator permission.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Retry the current result without clearing suspension or startup power protection. User calls require administrator permission.

clear_fields.name: Clear mask fields
clear_fields.description: Unset selected stored contributions without releasing mask activation. User calls require administrator permission.
